title: Do ovens use a lot of electricity?
desc: Ovens can consume a significant amount of electricity during operation. The exact usage depends on factors such as the oven's size, type, and cooking duration. Choosing energy-efficient models can help reduce electricity consumption.

title: Should you turn your oven off at the wall?
desc: It is generally unnecessary to switch off your oven at the wall socket after each use. Using the oven's built-in controls to turn it off is typically sufficient.

title: Does a built-in oven need to be vented?
desc: Built-in ovens often come equipped with built-in ventilation systems or can be installed with ventilation hoods. Ventilation helps to remove excess heat, steam, and cooking odours, thereby improving air quality in the kitchen.

title: Do built-in ovens get hot on the outside?
desc: Yes, built-in ovens can become hot on the exterior during operation. it's essential to exercise caution and avoid touching the outside, especially if young children are present. Some ovens are designed with better insulation to reduce external heat.

title: Is it safe to leave an electric oven on when not at home?
desc: It is generally not recommended to leave an electric oven unattended when you are not at home, as there is a potential fire hazard. It is advisable to use a timer or a cooking feature that automatically turns off the oven.

title: What is the expected lifespan of a built-in oven in Dubai?
desc: The expected lifespan of a built-in oven can vary depending on the brand, quality, and usage. On average, they last approximately 10-15 years. Regular maintenance and proper care can help extend their lifespan.

title: Why is my oven burning my food?
desc: If you're experiencing issues with your oven burning your food, it may be due to the highly efficient fan setting. When using the fan-assisted cooking feature, the rapid circulation of hot air can lead to higher temperatures than expected. To resolve this, try reducing the temperature setting by up to 10% to see if it improves cooking results. This adjustment should help compensate for the faster cooking times associated with fan assistance and prevent excessive browning or burning of your food.

title: Why isn't my oven heating up, but the light is working?
desc: If the light in your oven is functioning, it indicates that power is reaching the device. In this case, the issue is likely related to the oven elements responsible for the selected cooking function. If your appliance offers multiple options, try using a different oven function to continue cooking until a repair or replacement can be arranged. By switching to an alternative function, you may be able to bypass the faulty element and continue cooking with the remaining functional elements. Schedule a repair or replacement as soon as possible to ensure your appliance operates optimally. You can contact our Customer Care department at info@fajservices.ae to arrange for a technician to assess and resolve the issue.

title: Why does the cooling fan keep running after I turn the oven off?
desc: It is normal for the fan to continue running even after cooking is complete, as it actively cools down the oven. This is part of the oven's design to enhance safety and performance. The fan not only distributes hot air evenly throughout the oven cavity for consistent cooking but also operates after cooking to cool the oven to a safe temperature quickly. The duration of the fan's operation depends on the cooking temperature used—the higher the temperature, the longer the fan will run. Additionally, the ventilation surrounding your oven helps by allowing ambient air to assist in cooling the appliance. By efficiently circulating the air during the cooling process, the fan maintains a safe environment in your oven and minimises the time required for subsequent cooking cycles.

title: What type of oven is best?
desc: When it comes to choosing the best oven, an electric oven is generally preferred over a gas oven for baking. This is because electric ovens maintain a consistent temperature more effectively. Additionally, all convection ovens can operate without the convection feature turned on, so you can choose not to use it if you prefer.
